objective: Test whether a learned ThinkGate policy can reduce compute cost while preserving answer quality on genuine multi-step LLM traces.

estimator.leakage_rule: No eval task contributes to estimator fitting or margin selection.

split_policy.leakage_rule: All steps from the same task_id remain in one split.

quality_policy.requirement: Quality scoring must be declared before evaluation and must not use controller decisions.

cost_policy.definition: normalized model compute cost derived from tokens and/or latency
cost_policy.requirement: conversion must be frozen before final evaluation

success_rule: SUCCESS only if all three frozen gates pass on the untouched eval split.
evidence_status: No real-world performance claim until genuine held-out traces have been collected and evaluated.
